## Summary

I resolved ticket T-5004 by identifying that the API gateway pods use a `subPath` mount for their ConfigMap, which prevents automatic ConfigMap updates from being propagated to the running containers. The ConfigMap file hash in the logs never changed after the limit was updated, confirming the file wasn't refreshed. The fix is to restart the gateway pods to pick up the new configuration. I also recommended removing the `subPath` in future deployments to enable automatic ConfigMap updates as intended.
